eventMetadata.context_description: Ohio State's defensive dominance and superior recent form underpin their 56.5% implied probability as slight favorites over TCU in this college football clash. The Buckeyes rank top-10 nationally in total defense, allowing just 12.3 points per game through four undefeated outings, while TCU's offense has sputtered against Power Four foes, averaging under 20 points in Big 12 play. No major injuries reported on official updates for either side, but Ohio State's home-field advantage at Ohio Stadium and edge in quarterback experience—Will Howard's efficiency vs. Josh Hoover's inconsistency—bolster trader consensus. Historical head-to-head favors Buckeyes (2-0 since 2005), though TCU's up-tempo attack poses upset risk amid Ohio State's short-week prep.
